rationale: All 5 acceptance criteria pass. Three edge-case candidates (stale aria-label on placeholder→undefined; empty-string aria-label at runtime effect; empty-string aria-label at onLoad) were verified against every live call site: no caller transitions placeholder from a non-undefined value to undefined after mount, and no caller passes an empty string, so all three are unreachable in the current codebase and dismissed as noise. Standards audit not applicable by profile selection; 0 deferred, 3 filtered as noise.
